requirements.title: The client MUST define one schema-versioned declarative registry with unique stable feature IDs, bootstrap/eager/deferred phases, route/control identities, module/chunk identities, and explicit route/chunk budgets. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)
requirements.text: The client MUST define one schema-versioned declarative registry with unique stable feature IDs, bootstrap/eager/deferred phases, route/control identities, module/chunk identities, and explicit route/chunk budgets. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-001)

requirements.title: The Fable client MUST expose stable public loader state and messages, keep dynamic import at the JavaScript effect edge, and reject stale completions by requested feature/chunk identity. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: The Fable client MUST expose stable public loader state and messages, keep dynamic import at the JavaScript effect edge, and reject stale completions by requested feature/chunk identity. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: Deferred imports MUST use deterministic relative CSP-compatible targets, provide explicit offline/missing-chunk failure state, and preserve stable logical identity independently of content hashes. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: Deferred imports MUST use deterministic relative CSP-compatible targets, provide explicit offline/missing-chunk failure state, and preserve stable logical identity independently of content hashes. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: The build gate MUST derive and enforce versioned raw/gzip/Brotli budgets for the bootstrap route, each initial route, and every deferred feature chunk from the #154 loading SLO. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: The build gate MUST derive and enforce versioned raw/gzip/Brotli budgets for the bootstrap route, each initial route, and every deferred feature chunk from the #154 loading SLO. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: Vite/minifier configuration MUST prohibit property-name mangling as a delivery-growth remedy and the gate MUST reject it if introduced. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: Vite/minifier configuration MUST prohibit property-name mangling as a delivery-growth remedy and the gate MUST reject it if introduced. (Stories: US-002, US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: Rules Explorer, Docs, and Tactical Environment MUST be registered and qualified through the same loader contract, and unregistered future feature imports MUST fail validation. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001, AC-002)
requirements.text: Rules Explorer, Docs, and Tactical Environment MUST be registered and qualified through the same loader contract, and unregistered future feature imports MUST fail validation. (Stories: US-001, US-002; Acceptance: AC-001, AC-002)

requirements.title: The build gate MUST fail when registered deferred feature code becomes eagerly reachable outside the registry-declared import boundary and name the leaked feature/module path. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)
requirements.text: The build gate MUST fail when registered deferred feature code becomes eagerly reachable outside the registry-declared import boundary and name the leaked feature/module path. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-004)

requirements.title: A real production browser MUST prove the shell boots first and each registered feature loads through its actual user-facing control rather than direct message injection or a test-only seam. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-002)
requirements.text: A real production browser MUST prove the shell boots first and each registered feature loads through its actual user-facing control rather than direct message injection or a test-only seam. (Stories: US-001; Acceptance: AC-002)

requirements.title: Automated mutations MUST prove eager import, missing chunk, and stale chunk identity each turn its owning gate red with a subject-specific diagnostic. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-005)
requirements.text: Automated mutations MUST prove eager import, missing chunk, and stale chunk identity each turn its owning gate red with a subject-specific diagnostic. (Stories: US-003; Acceptance: AC-005)

requirements.title: The build MUST emit a deterministic normalized bundle-graph receipt bound to registry digest, input/source digest, emitted chunk identities, route membership, budgets, and content digests, excluding timestamps and machine-local paths. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)
requirements.text: The build MUST emit a deterministic normalized bundle-graph receipt bound to registry digest, input/source digest, emitted chunk identities, route membership, budgets, and content digests, excluding timestamps and machine-local paths. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-003)

requirements.title: Acceptance MUST use focused edit-time tests followed by one source-frozen aggregate that creates immutable/content-addressed receipts; changing feedback-only metadata MUST not rebuild product artifacts. (Stories: US-002; Acceptance: AC-006)

decisions.title: Registry v1 declares shell/bootstrap, tactical-environment/eager, rules-explorer/deferred, and docs/deferred; only deferred entries own dynamic import targets.
decisions.decision: Registry v1 declares shell/bootstrap, tactical-environment/eager, rules-explorer/deferred, and docs/deferred; only deferred entries own dynamic import targets.

decisions.title: Public state is Idle, Loading request, Loaded identity, or Failed identity/reason; request identity is `(registryVersion, featureId, logicalChunkId)` and mismatched completions are ignored with a stable stale-identity diagnostic.
decisions.decision: Public state is Idle, Loading request, Loaded identity, or Failed identity/reason; request identity is `(registryVersion, featureId, logicalChunkId)` and mismatched completions are ignored with a stable stale-identity diagnostic.

decisions.title: Keep #154 version-2 initial and Rules Explorer budgets. Author Docs from the first source-frozen observation with explicit headroom, and require a registry version/rebaseline plus red budget mutation for any increase.
decisions.decision: Keep #154 version-2 initial and Rules Explorer budgets. Author Docs from the first source-frozen observation with explicit headroom, and require a registry version/rebaseline plus red budget mutation for any increase.

decisions.title: Browser acceptance uses only production controls and visible named regions: shell readiness, Data/Rules Explorer, Docs/help, and Editor/Environment. Direct reducer dispatch is not acceptance evidence.
decisions.decision: Browser acceptance uses only production controls and visible named regions: shell readiness, Data/Rules Explorer, Docs/help, and Editor/Environment. Direct reducer dispatch is not acceptance evidence.

decisions.title: One post-build validator owns eager-edge analysis, budgets, minifier policy, and canonical graph receipt generation; one source-frozen aggregate creates receipts, while feedback-only paths are excluded from build workflow triggers.
decisions.decision: One post-build validator owns eager-edge analysis, budgets, minifier policy, and canonical graph receipt generation; one source-frozen aggregate creates receipts, while feedback-only paths are excluded from build workflow triggers.
